longdong.name: Longdong
longdong.description: Taiwan's largest natural crag with more than 600 climbing routes, located in Gongliao District, New Taipei City

kenting.name: Kenting
kenting.description: Southern Taiwan's signature coral-reef limestone sport climbing crag, located in Hengchun Township, Pingtung County

guanziling.name: Guanziling
guanziling.description: A well-known limestone climbing area in Tainan, famous for its unique mud hot springs and quality rock

defulan.name: Defulan
defulan.description: A quartz sandstone crag in Heping District, Taichung, with a mix of sport and trad routes

shoushan.name: Shoushan (Dapao Rock)
shoushan.description: A natural crag on Shoushan in Kaohsiung, well suited to beginners trying outdoor climbing
